item.text: AssemblyAI supports speaker labels and redaction policies for names, phone numbers, and Social Security numbers. Implemented [run.sh](/work/run.sh). Run:

```sh
./run.sh <audio.wav> <out.json>
```

Tested successfully with `sample.wav`: two speaker labels, redacted names/SSN/phone number, and the required JSON format. AssemblyAI’s retained transcript matched the redacted output and was left intact. Failure checks passed.

Automated redaction can miss PII; strict no-PII requirements still need review. Details in [README.md](/work/README.md).
